title: Risk-Aware Multi-Scenario Trade-Off Optimization

established_reference_ladder.arm_b: Static q10 conservative control (Primary reliability benchmark)

levels.name: Critical Reliability (J1)
levels.mathematical_expression: sum_{s=0}^{S-1} pi_s sum_{t=0}^{H-1} P_unmet_crit[t, s] * dt
levels.rationale: Strictly prioritizes critical load satisfaction across all scenarios, especially protecting against downside scenario deficits.

levels.name: Governed Reserve Envelope Protection (J2)
levels.rationale: Maintains 6h EBR critical lookahead reserve and terminal target reserve across plausible realizations.

levels.name: Resource-Aware Diesel Fuel & Cycling Efficiency (J3)
levels.mathematical_expression: sum_{t=0}^{H-1} (m_fuel * p_diesel[t] + b_fuel * u_diesel[t] + s_fuel * v_start[t] + c_deg * p_dis[t]) * dt
levels.rationale: Prioritizes minimizing diesel fuel expenditure before curtailment, eliminating unnecessary diesel commitment while lightly discouraging gratuitous battery cycling.

levels.name: Renewable Curtailment Minimization (J4)
levels.mathematical_expression: sum_{s=0}^{S-1} pi_s sum_{t=0}^{H-1} (p_curt_sol[t, s] + p_curt_wind[t, s]) * dt
levels.rationale: Absorbs available renewable energy into battery charging ceiling without compromising diesel efficiency or reserve.

unmet_load_gate.threshold: Arm F total realized unmet critical load <= Arm B total realized unmet critical load + 10%
unmet_load_gate.statistical_test: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test and 10,000 bootstrap 95% CI on (Arm F - Arm B) unmet load

diesel_goal.primary: Arm F total realized diesel < Arm D total realized diesel
diesel_goal.secondary: Arm F diesel approaches Arm B diesel without sacrificing reliability

battery_cycling.target: Arm F retains a meaningful fraction of Arm D's EFC reduction relative to Arm B

curtailment.target: Arm F curtailment < Arm B curtailment

governance_rule: NO PRODUCTION PROMOTION AUTHORIZED. 2024 evaluation outcomes were not used to select, tune, or modify the L2-EXP-10 formulation after pre-registration.
